questions.text: What does Amir study at WKU?
questions.hint: "My name is Amir Bekzhanov. I study Computer Science at WKU."

questions.text: Amir's first lecture starts at 9:15 in the morning.
questions.hint: "I am not attending a lecture at this moment because my first class starts at eleven."

questions.text: Where is Amir sitting at the start of the text?
questions.hint: "I am sitting in the WKU library on the second floor."

questions.text: Amir closes his laptop at ___ and prepares to go to his lecture.
questions.hint: "At 10:45 I close my laptop and pick up my bag. My lecture is starting in fifteen minutes."

questions.text: Why is Malika studying in the library today instead of her room?
opts: The library is closer to her lecture
questions.hint: "Today she is in the library because her internet is not working."

questions.text: The student near the window in the library is talking on the phone.
questions.hint: The student near the WINDOW is sleeping on his notebook. It is the student near the ENTRANCE who is talking on the phone.

questions.text: What is Bekzat doing when Amir sees him in the cafeteria?
opts: Eating porridge and reading a textbook
questions.correct: Eating porridge and reading a textbook
questions.hint: "My friend Bekzat is sitting at a corner table. He is eating a bowl of porridge and reading a textbook at the same time."

questions.text: What is Amir's father doing when Amir calls home?
opts: Playing with Dinara in the garden
Fixing the car in the garage
questions.correct: Fixing the car in the garage
questions.hint: "My father is fixing the car in the garage." — Amir's mother tells him.

questions.text: Where is Sholpan when Amir calls her?
questions.hint: "I'm eating lunch in the cafeteria. Why?" — Sholpan answers Amir's call.

questions.text: Dastan is helping Amir write the code for the project.
questions.hint: "He's playing football outside with the sports club. Again." — Sholpan tells Amir where Dastan is.

questions.text: Sholpan tells Amir that the project deadline is ___.
questions.hint: "Are you working on the project? The deadline is tomorrow!" — Amir says this at the start of the call.

questions.text: What is Malika doing in the WKU café during the video call?
opts: Waiting for a lecture to start
Drinking coffee and reading her Psychology notes
questions.correct: Drinking coffee and reading her Psychology notes
questions.hint: "I'm reading my Psychology notes. And drinking coffee. And now I'm talking to you!" — Malika to Aigerim.

questions.text: The two boys arguing near Malika are from the Physics faculty.
questions.hint: "Two boys from the Engineering faculty. They're arguing about something!" — Malika. Engineering, not Physics.

questions.text: What is Aigerim doing during the video call with Malika?
opts: Having coffee in the WKU café
Sitting in the library and pretending to study
questions.correct: Sitting in the library and pretending to study
questions.hint: "I'm sitting in the library. I'm listening to you... and pretending to study." — Aigerim.

questions.text: "___ Malika reading her notes?" — "Yes, she ___!"
questions.hint: Malika = she (singular) → IS. Short answer: "Yes, she IS." (never "Yes, she's.")

questions.text: "I am knowing the answer to this question" is correct English.
questions.hint: "Know" is a stative verb — it NEVER takes -ing! → "I know the answer." ✅ Stative verbs: know, like, love, want, understand.

questions.text: The correct -ing form of the verb "sit" is ___.
questions.hint: "sit" = consonant + vowel + consonant (s-i-t) → double the last letter! sit → sitting. "Amir is sitting in the library."

questions.text: Which sentence uses Present Continuous correctly?
opts: "She is wanting another coffee right now."
"I am knowing all the spelling rules."
"Look — the professor is writing on the board!"
questions.correct: "Look — the professor is writing on the board!"
questions.hint: "Look!" = signal for Present Continuous. "write" is an action verb → writing ✅. The others use stative verbs (want, know, understand) which never take -ing.

questions.text: Malika usually ___ in her room, but today she ___ in the library.
questions.hint: "Usually" → Present Simple: studies ✅. "Today" (temporary situation) → Present Continuous: is studying ✅.

questions.text: "Are you coming to the library?" — "Yes, I'm." is a correct short answer.
questions.hint: You can NEVER use a contraction in a short positive answer! → "Yes, I AM." ✅ "Yes, I'm." ❌

questions.text: The correct -ing form of the verb "write" is ___.
questions.hint: "write" ends in -e → drop the -e, add -ing: write → writing. "The professor is writing on the board."

questions.text: Which is a signal word for Present Continuous?
questions.hint: "right now / at the moment / look! / listen!" → Present Continuous. "every morning / usually / always" → Present Simple.

questions.text: What does "deadline" mean?
opts: The beginning of a new project
A long line of waiting people
The latest time by which something must be finished
questions.correct: The latest time by which something must be finished
questions.hint: "The deadline is tomorrow!" — Amir. Deadline = срок сдачи — the last moment to hand in your work.

questions.text: "Starving" means feeling just a little bit hungry.
questions.hint: "Starving" (informal) = EXTREMELY hungry. "I'm starving!" — Sholpan says this because she hasn't eaten all morning.

questions.text: The opposite of "permanent" is ___.
questions.hint: Temporary (временный) = lasting only a short time. The opposite of permanent (постоянный). Malika is in the library — it's a temporary situation.

questions.text: What does "concentrate" mean?
opts: to relax and take a break
to remember something from the past
to focus all your attention on one thing
to work very quickly without stopping
questions.correct: to focus all your attention on one thing
questions.hint: "Amir is trying hard to concentrate during the lecture." Concentrate = to focus, to give your full attention.

questions.text: What is a "barista"?
opts: A person whose job is to make and serve coffee
questions.correct: A person whose job is to make and serve coffee
questions.hint: "The barista is making a cappuccino — it smells absolutely amazing!" — Malika describes the WKU café.

questions.text: "Meanwhile" means before something else happens.
questions.hint: "Meanwhile" = at the SAME TIME as something else. "Amir is studying. Meanwhile, Dastan is playing football." — both things happen simultaneously.

questions.text: Dastan is playing football ___ of working on the project.
questions.hint: "Instead" = in place of; as an alternative. "Dastan is playing football INSTEAD OF working on the project." — Sholpan tells Amir.

questions.text: What does "fascinating" mean?
questions.hint: "This book about memory is fascinating!" — Malika. Fascinating = захватывающий / увлекательный — something you find very interesting.
